t_explain.question_or_instruction: Explain the key clauses of this agreement in simple borrower-friendly language, focusing on points that relate to the user's question.
t_explain.answer:
Based on the provided document, I will explain the key clauses that relate to the user's question.

**What happens if I miss a payment?**

According to [CLAUSE 6], if any payment is 10 days late, the Lender may charge a late fee of $25. This is mentioned in the "LATE FEE" section.

**Can I pay back the loan early?**

Yes, according to [CLAUSE 3], the Borrower has the right to pay back the loan in full or make additional payments at any time without penalty. This is mentioned in the "PREPAYMENT" section.

**What happens if the loan is not paid back?**

According to [CLAUSE 1], if an "Event of Acceleration" occurs, the Lender may declare the balance of the loan and the security (if any) immediately due and payable. This is mentioned in the "ACCELERATION" section.

**What is the interest rate on the loan?**

According to [CLAUSE 5], the loan will bear interest at a rate of 8% compounded annually. This is mentioned in the "INTEREST" section.

**How will my payments be applied?**

According to [CLAUSE 6], all payments made by the Borrower will be applied first to any accrued interest and secondly to the principal balance. This is mentioned in the "PAYMENT INSTRUCTIONS" section.

**What happens if the security (if any) is sold or transferred?**

According to [CLAUSE 2], the security may not be sold or transferred without the Lender's consent until the Due Date. If the Borrower breaches this provision, the Lender may declare all sums due under this Agreement immediately due and payable, unless prohibited by applicable law. This is mentioned in the "SECURITY" section.
